shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,100p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && cat package.json && sed -n '1,240p' src/App.tsx && sed -n '1,160p' src/main.tsx && rg -n 'Toast|Toaster|Notification|Alert|Button|toast' src"

/bin/bash -lc ".agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Button Toaster Toast useToaster && rg -n -C 3 'Toast|Toaster|Button view|notifications' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md"

/bin/bash -lc "bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Button Toaster Toast useToaster; rg -n -C 3 'Toast|Toaster|Button view|notifications' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n -C 4 'Toaster|toast|Required setup' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md; sed -n '1,220p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster/Toaster.d.ts; sed -n '1,220p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster/types.d.ts; sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster/hooks/useToaster.d.ts; sed -n '1,160p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.d.ts; sed -n '1,160p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster/Provider/ToasterProvider.d.ts; sed -n '1,140p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/index.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster/index.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster/ToasterComponent/ToasterComponent.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster/Provider/ToasterContext.d.ts; rg -n 'Toaster' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build -g '*.md' | head -30; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/toaster-singleton.d.ts; sed -n '1,120p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster/constants.d.ts;"

/bin/bash -lc 'cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster/Toaster.js | head -100; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster/ToasterComponent/ToasterComponent.js | head -90; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster/hooks/useToaster.js; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster/withToaster.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/toaster-singleton.js; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster/Toast/Toast.d.ts'

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | rg -n -C 3 'exports|types|main'; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm | head; rg -n 'toaster' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm -g 'index.*' | head"
